name: Full Day
description: The roll is 86400, the seconds in one day.

name: Always
description: The roll is 247365 or 365247: 24/7, all year.

name: 13th Power
description: Some whole number to the 13th power.

name: 17th Power
description: Some whole number to the 17th power.

name: 19th Power
description: Some whole number to the 19th power.

name: Tau
description: The roll is τ cut short: 6283, 62831 or 628318.

name: Golden Ratio
description: The roll is φ cut short: 1618, 16180 or 161803.

name: 10th Power
description: Some whole number to the 10th power.

name: 11th Power
description: Some whole number to the 11th power.

name: 4 Consecutive Numbers
description: Cut in four, the pieces count up or down by one, in order.

name: Pi
description: The roll is π cut short: 314, 3141, 31415 or 314159.

name: Euler's Number
description: The roll is e cut short: 271, 2718, 27182 or 271828.

name: 9th Power
description: Some whole number to the 9th power.

name: 8th Power
description: Some whole number to the 8th power.

name: Ouroboros
description: A number raised to its own power: 1¹, 2², 3³ … up to 7⁷.

name: 7th Power
description: Some whole number to the 7th power.

name: Factorial
description: Equal to 1 × 2 × 3 × … up to some whole number.

name: Sequence (6)
description: Six digits in a row counting up or down by one.

name: Hello
description: Has 07734 in it, which reads HELLO on an upside-down calculator.

name: Contiguous Sixes
description: The same digit six times in a row.

name: 6th Power
description: Some whole number to the 6th power.

name: 5th Power
description: Some whole number to the 5th power.
Has 58008 in it, the upside-down calculator classic.
Has 80085 in it, the right-way-up calculator classic.

name: Fibonacci Number
description: Appears in the sequence 0, 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13… where each term is the sum of the two before.

name: Cascade
description: Counts up by one from start to finish, like 3456.

name: 4th Power
description: Some whole number to the 4th power.

name: Waterfall
description: Counts down by one from start to finish, like 6543.

name: 4 Consecutive Numbers (Contains)
description: Somewhere inside, four numbers count up or down by one back to back.

name: 4 Consecutive Numbers (Scrambled)
description: Cut in four, the pieces are consecutive numbers but out of order.

name: Homogeneous
description: Two or more digits, all the same.

name: Spy Number
description: Adding its digits gives the same result as multiplying them.

name: Even Spacing
description: Three or more digits that change by the same amount each step.

name: 3 Consecutive Numbers
description: Cut in three, the pieces count up or down by one, in order.

name: Contiguous Fives
description: The same digit five times in a row.

name: Strobogrammatic
description: Turn it upside down and it still reads the same.

name: Straight
description: Five digits in a row counting up or down by one, like 34567.

name: Hell
description: Has 7734 in it, which reads HELL on an upside-down calculator.
Has 8008 in it, a calculator classic.

name: 3 Consecutive Numbers (Scrambled)
description: Cut in three, the pieces are consecutive numbers but out of order.

name: Zipper
description: Two digits taking turns, never the same one twice in a row.

name: Ascension
description: Each digit is bigger than the one before.

name: Crescendo
description: Cut into three or more numbers that grow or shrink by the same ratio.

name: Five of a Kind
description: Some digit appears five or more times.

name: 3 Consecutive Numbers (Contains)
description: Somewhere inside, three numbers count up or down by one back to back.

name: Contiguous Three Pair
description: Three different doubled digits back to back, like 113355.

name: Framed Pair
description: Four digits: a doubled digit in the middle, with different digits on each end.

name: Framed Triple
description: Five digits: a tripled digit in the middle, with different digits on each end.

name: Framed Quad
description: Six digits: the middle four identical, with different digits on each end.

name: Decay
description: Each digit is smaller than the one before.

name: Echo
description: The second half is a copy of the first half.

name: Pronic Number
description: Equal to some whole number times the next one up, like 6 = 2 × 3.

name: 2nd Power
description: Some whole number multiplied by itself.

name: Even Spacing (Absolute)
description: Three or more digits that move the same distance each step, up or down.

name: Firefly
description: At least four digits: one odd one out, all the rest identical.

name: 2 Consecutive Numbers
description: Cut in two, the halves are consecutive numbers, like 1213.

name: Palindrome
description: Identical read left to right or right to left.

name: Contiguous Quads
description: The same digit four times in a row.

name: Turtle
description: Neighbouring digits are never more than one apart.

name: Heavy
description: Its digits add up to more than 45.

name: Contiguous Full House
description: A block of three or more of one digit right next to a block of two or more of another.

name: Sequence (4)
description: Four digits in a row counting up or down by one.

name: Orientation
description: Has 101 in it, like an intro course.

name: Calendar
description: Has 365 in it, one for every day of the year.

name: Scramble
description: Sort the digits and they count up by one with no gaps or repeats.

name: Duality
description: Built from exactly two different digits.

name: Steps
description: Digits only go up or stay level, rising at least once.

name: Metronome
description: Cut into three or more numbers that go up or down by the same gap (bigger than 1).

name: Framed Double
description: Six digits: two different doubled digits in the middle, with different digits on each end.

name: Slopes
description: Digits only go down or stay level, falling at least once.

name: Paired Bookends
description: Opens with a doubled digit and closes with a different doubled digit.

name: Three Pair
description: Three different digits each appear exactly twice.

name: Bookends
description: The opening two digits reappear as the closing two.

name: Mirror Bookends
description: The closing two digits are the opening two flipped around.

name: Four of a Kind
description: Some digit appears four or more times.

name: Equation
description: Cut into three numbers a, b, c so that a + b, a − b, a × b or a ÷ b equals c.

name: Mountain
description: Digits climb strictly to a single peak, then drop strictly.

name: Double Hop
description: A digit skips one place and lands again, three times in a row.

name: Valley
description: Digits drop strictly to a single low point, then climb strictly.

name: Contiguous Two Pair
description: Two different doubled digits back to back, like 3377.

name: Flush
description: Every digit is even, or every digit is odd.

name: Alternator
description: Digits switch between odd and even at every step.

name: Contiguous Trips
description: The same digit three times in a row.

name: Feather
description: Its digits add up to less than 15.

name: Blackjack
description: Its digits add up to exactly 21.

name: Full House
description: One digit at least three times plus another at least twice.

name: Pocket Mirror
description: Hides a palindrome at least 4 digits long.

name: Snake Eyes
description: Two 1s, and no other digit appears more than once.

name: Eighty-Six
description: Has 86 in it, kitchen slang for "we're out".

name: Balanced
description: An even number of digits, with both halves adding up to the same total.

name: Rhyme
description: The same chunk of 2+ digits shows up twice without overlapping.

name: Sequence (3)
description: Three digits in a row counting up or down by one.

name: 2 Consecutive Numbers (Contains)
description: Somewhere inside, a number is followed directly by the next or previous number.

name: 2 Consecutive Numbers (Nearby)
description: Two separate pieces of the roll, with a gap between them, are one apart.

name: Mesa
description: Digits go up, then down, with level stretches allowed but no second climb.

name: Prime Number
description: Only 1 and itself divide it evenly.

name: Trinity
description: Built from exactly three different digits.

name: Canyon
description: Digits go down, then up, with level stretches allowed but no second drop.

name: Harshad Number
description: Divides evenly by the sum of its own digits.

name: Equilibrium
description: Starts and ends with the same digit.

name: Sandwich
description: Same digit at both ends, with something different in between.

name: Hills
description: At least four digits that zigzag up, down, up… with no repeats side by side.

name: Three of a Kind
description: Some digit appears exactly three times.

name: Mini Scramble
description: Three or more side-by-side digits that count up by one once sorted.

name: Gap One
description: First and last digits are one apart.

name: Two Pair
description: Two different digits each appear at least twice.

name: Dunes
description: Zigzags up and down once you ignore level stretches, with at least four turns’ worth of digits.

name: Hopscotch
description: A digit skips one place and lands again, exactly twice in that pattern.

name: Quartet
description: Built from exactly four different digits.

name: Grounded
description: Starts with a smaller digit than it ends with.

name: Contiguous Pair
description: The same digit twice side by side.

name: Liftoff
description: Starts with a bigger digit than it ends with.

name: Neighbors
description: Two side-by-side digits that are one apart.

name: Pair
description: Some digit appears at least twice.
